title: Release notes: Sprint 26.20
label: Release notes Sprint 26.20
lead: What changed for users this sprint, in plain words. Review it, correct anything, and approve it to save and share.

blocks.title: In short
bullets: Care coordinators can override program thresholds directly in Acme Claims.
Analysts can filter Member Journey by program year instead of exporting to Excel.

cards.title: Threshold override screen
fields: Coordinators override a threshold from the member record. Each change is saved with a reason and shows in the audit history.
An override is saved and shows on the member record
Every override writes an audit row

cards.title: Program year filter
fields: A program year selector sits above Member Journey and the reports, and the choice carries across pages.
The filter is kept when moving between pages
